agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every selected verification test path must be discovered from the current repository before command construction.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first small governance selection named a nonexistent current-Baton test file and pytest rejected it before collection.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest returned file-or-directory-not-found before executing a test.

correction.action: Discover the exact current Baton consistency test path with repository file search and use that path in the passing selection.
correction.prevention_control: Generate verification manifests from repository-discovered test paths rather than recalled filenames.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one precollection nonexistent-test-path lapse and selects repository-discovered manifests.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Pytest arguments supplied to the serial runner must follow the required separator in its typed command form.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first serial-runner invocation placed -q before the separator and argparse rejected it before collection.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The serial runner returned unrecognized-arguments before acquiring or running the test manifest.

correction.action: Use the documented separator before all pytest arguments; the corrected invocation passed.
correction.prevention_control: Generate serial-runner invocations from a typed command form that inserts the separator mechanically.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one precollection serial-runner argument-shape lapse and selects typed command generation.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every yielded long-running command must retain its session identifier until final exit and complete output are read back.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first 164-test run yielded a session identifier inside a result object whose output alone was retained; the run completed but its final exit could not be read back, requiring one redundant full rerun.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Process inspection showed the original run continued to completion while the orchestrator no longer held its session identifier.

correction.action: Retain the complete execution result, poll the yielded session to final exit and record the passing 164-test result.
correction.prevention_control: Route every potentially long command through one typed controller that persists and polls the returned session identifier.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one redundant regression run caused by lost yielded-session state and selects mandatory session capture.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The live active-operation latch is a clockwork-owned canonical surface and may change only through the clockwork writer.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The orchestrator directly edited the latch at plan freeze; the closeout dry run rejected canonical_drift before publication.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork live-state validator rejected the dry run and wrote no canonical projection.

correction.action: Restore the exact previous latch bytes and submit the successor state only through the clockwork closeout transaction.
correction.prevention_control: Prohibit direct writes to every clockwork-owned canonical surface, including named plan checkpoints.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one clockwork-rejected direct latch edit and restores single-writer ownership before publication.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Canonical evidence written at a full source object must remain idempotently readable after descendant commits.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first postcommit check rebuilt evidence against live HEAD rather than its retained full source object and rejected its own canonical bytes as drifted.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The postcommit --check path returned existing_evidence_noncanonical_or_drifted before closeout publication.

correction.action: Retain the existing full source binding, prove it is an ancestor of current HEAD and rebuild canonical evidence against that retained object.
correction.prevention_control: Every evidence readback must validate its stored full object as an ancestor rather than silently substitute live HEAD.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and repairs one postcommit evidence-head rebinding defect with stable full-object ancestry.
